focus.name: scene-transition-digit-wrappers
focus.purpose: Name the fixed-divisor wrappers around SceneTransition_WriteDecimalDigit while preserving the units fallthrough alias into the shared helper.

shared_helper.name: SceneTransition_WriteDecimalDigit
shared_helper.contract: Extract the next decimal digit from D3 using D4, emit it through VDP_WriteTileWord, increment D0, and return with the remainder in D3.

relationships: The seven existing and five newly named wrappers load fixed decimal divisors in descending order before calling the shared helper, forming the complete 1,000,000,000 through 1 digit sequence.
The units entry at 0x001B34AE has no local RTS; it falls through directly to SceneTransition_WriteDecimalDigit and is therefore recorded as an alias, not an independent function.
limitations: The surrounding caller and displayed numeric field are not assigned here; only the fixed-divisor formatter contract is established.
